1.english_reference: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel

traditions.KJV: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel
by Malachi .

traditions.LXX: θέσθε δὴ ἐπὶ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν .

traditions.KJV: I have loved you ,
saith the LORD .
Yet ye say ,
Wherein hast thou loved us ? [ Was ]

traditions.WLC: הֲ לוֹא אָ֨ח עֵשָׂ֤ו לְ יַֽעֲקֹב֙
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἀδελφὸς ἦν Ἠσαὺ τοῦ Ἰακώβ ;
traditions.KJV: not Esau Jacob ’s brother ?
saith the LORD :
yet I loved Jacob ,
And I hated Esau ,

3.english_reference: and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness

traditions.WLC: וָ אָשִׂ֤ים אֶת הָרָי ו֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְ אֶת נַחֲלָת֖ וֹ לְ תַנּ֥וֹת מִדְבָּֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔταξα τὰ ὅρια αὐτοῦ εἰς ἀφανισμὸν καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ εἰς δόματα ἐρήμου .
traditions.VUL: et pósui montes eius in solitúdinem , et hereditátem eius in dracónes desérti .
traditions.KJV: and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness .
Whereas Edom saith ,
We are impoverished ,

4.english_reference: but we will return and build the desolate places ;

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιστρέψωμεν καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσωμεν τὰς ἐρήμους .
traditions.VUL: sed reverténtes ædificábimus quæ destrúcta sunt :
traditions.KJV: but we will return and build the desolate places ;

4.english_reference: thus saith the LORD of hosts ,

traditions.KJV: thus saith the LORD of hosts ,
They shall build ,
but I will throw down ;
and they shall call them ,
The border of wickedness ,
and ,

4.english_reference: The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever .

traditions.WLC: הָ עָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר זָעַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: λαὸς ἐφ᾽ ὃν παρατέτακται Κύριος ἕως αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: pópulus , cui irátus est Dóminus usque in ætérnum .
traditions.KJV: The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever .
And your eyes shall see ,

5.english_reference: and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֤ם תֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה מֵ עַ֖ל לִ גְב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐρεῖτε Ἐμεγαλύνθη Κύριος ὑπεράνω τῶν ὁρίων τοῦ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et vos dicétis : Magnificétur Dóminus super términum Israel .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall say , The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel .
A son honoureth [ his ] father ,
and a servant his master :

6.english_reference: if then I [ be ] a father ,

traditions.KJV: if then I [ be ] a father ,
where [ is ] mine honour ?

6.english_reference: and if I [ be ] a master ,

traditions.KJV: and if I [ be ] a master ,
where [ is ] my fear ?

6.english_reference: saith the LORD of hosts unto you ,

traditions.KJV: saith the LORD of hosts unto you ,
O priests ,
that despise my name .
And ye say ,

6.english_reference: Wherein have we despised thy name ?

traditions.WLC: בַּ מֶּ֥ה בָזִ֖ינוּ אֶת שְׁמֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τίνι ἐφαυλίσαμεν τὸ ὄνομά σου ;
traditions.KJV: Wherein have we despised thy name ?

7.english_reference: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar ;

traditions.WLC: מַגִּישִׁ֤ים עַֽל מִזְבְּחִ י֙ לֶ֣חֶם מְגֹאָ֔ל
traditions.LXX: προσάγοντες πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριόν μου ἄρτους ἠλισγημένους .
traditions.VUL: Offértis super altáre meum panem pollútum ,
traditions.KJV: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar ;
and ye say ,
Wherein have we polluted thee ?
In that ye say ,

7.english_reference: The table of the LORD [ is ] contemptible .

traditions.LXX: Τράπεζα Κυρίου ἠλισγημένη ἐστίν , καὶ τὰ ἐπιτιθέμενα ἐξουδενώσατε .
traditions.KJV: The table of the LORD [ is ] contemptible .

8.english_reference: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כִֽי תַגִּשׁ֨וּ ן עִוֵּ֤ר לִ זְבֹּ֨חַ֙
traditions.LXX: διότι ἐὰν προσαγάγητε τυφλὸν εἰς θυσίαν ,
traditions.KJV: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice , [ is it ]
not evil ?

8.english_reference: and if ye offer the lame and sick ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ֥י תַגִּ֛ישׁוּ פִּסֵּ֥חַ וְ חֹלֶ֖ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν προσαγάγητε χωλὸν ἢ ἄρρωστον ,
traditions.VUL: et si offerátis claudum , et lánguidum ,
traditions.KJV: and if ye offer the lame and sick , [ is it ]
not evil ?

8.english_reference: offer it now unto thy governor ;

traditions.WLC: הַקְרִיבֵ֨ הוּ נָ֜א לְ פֶחָתֶ֗ ךָ
traditions.LXX: προσάγαγε δὴ αὐτὸ τῷ ἡγουμένῳ σου ,
traditions.KJV: offer it now unto thy governor ;

8.english_reference: will he be pleased with thee ,

traditions.KJV: will he be pleased with thee ,
or accept thy person ?
saith the LORD of hosts .

9.english_reference: And now , I pray you , beseech God that he will be gracious unto us :

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֛ה חַלּוּ נָ֥א פְנֵי אֵ֖ל וִֽ יחָנֵ֑ נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἐξιλάσκεσθε τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν καὶ δεήθητε αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Et nunc deprecámini vultum Dei ut misereátur vestri
traditions.KJV: And now , I pray you , beseech God that he will be gracious unto us :

9.english_reference: this hath been by your means :

traditions.VUL: ( de manu enim vestra factum est hoc )
traditions.KJV: this hath been by your means :

traditions.LXX: εἰ λήμψομαι ἐξ ὑμῶν πρόσωπα ὑμῶν ;
traditions.KJV: will he regard your persons ?
saith the LORD of hosts .

10.english_reference: Who [ is there ] even among you that would shut the doors [ for nought ] ?

traditions.WLC: מִ֤י גַם בָּ כֶם֙ וְ יִסְגֹּ֣ר דְּלָתַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: διότι καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν συνκλεισθήσονται θύραι ,
traditions.VUL: Quis est in vobis , qui claudat óstia ,
traditions.KJV: Who [ is there ] even among you that would shut the doors [ for nought ] ?

10.english_reference: neither do ye kindle [ fire ] on mine altar for nought .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא תָאִ֥ירוּ מִזְבְּחִ֖ י חִנָּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἀνάψεται τὸ θυσιαστήριόν μου δωρεάν ·
traditions.KJV: neither do ye kindle [ fire ] on mine altar for nought .

10.english_reference: I have no pleasure in you ,

traditions.WLC: אֵֽין לִ֨ י חֵ֜פֶץ בָּ כֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἔστιν μου θέλημα ἐν ὑμῖν ,
traditions.VUL: non est mihi volúntas in vobis ,
traditions.KJV: I have no pleasure in you ,
saith the LORD of hosts ,

10.english_reference: neither will I accept an offering at your hand .

traditions.WLC: וּ מִנְחָ֖ה לֹֽא אֶרְצֶ֥ה מִ יֶּדְ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ θυσίαν οὐ προσδέξομαι ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: et munus non suscípiam de manu vestra .
traditions.KJV: neither will I accept an offering at your hand .

11.english_reference: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י מִ מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֜מֶשׁ וְ עַד מְבוֹא֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: διότι ἀπ᾽ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου καὶ ἕως δυσμῶν
traditions.VUL: Ab ortu enim solis usque ad occásum ,
traditions.KJV: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same

11.english_reference: my name [ shall be ] great among the Gentiles

traditions.LXX: τὸ ὄνομά μου δεδόξασται ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: magnum est nomen meum in géntibus ,
traditions.KJV: my name [ shall be ] great among the Gentiles ;

11.english_reference: and in every place incense [ shall be ] offered unto my name , and a pure offering

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל מָק֗וֹם מֻקְטָ֥ר מֻגָּ֛שׁ לִ שְׁמִ֖ י וּ מִנְחָ֣ה טְהוֹרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ θυμίαμα προσάγεται τῷ ὀνόματὶ μου καὶ θυσία καθαρά ·
traditions.VUL: et in omni loco sacrificátur , et offértur nómini meo oblátio munda :
traditions.KJV: and in every place incense [ shall be ] offered unto my name , and a pure offering :

11.english_reference: for my name [ shall be ] great among the heathen

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי גָד֤וֹל שְׁמִ י֙ בַּ גּוֹיִ֔ם
traditions.LXX: διότι μέγα τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: quia magnum est nomen meum in géntibus ,
traditions.KJV: for my name [ shall be ] great among the heathen ,
saith the LORD of hosts .

traditions.VUL: Et vos polluístis illud in eo ,
traditions.KJV: But ye have profaned it ,

12.english_reference: in that ye say , The table of the LORD [ is ] polluted ;

traditions.WLC: בֶּ אֱמָרְ כֶ֗ם שֻׁלְחַ֤ן אֲדֹנָ י֙ מְגֹאָ֣ל ה֔וּא
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ λέγειν ὑμᾶς Τράπεζα Κυρίου ἠλισγημένη ἐστίν ,
traditions.VUL: quod dícitis : Mensa Dómini contamináta est :
traditions.KJV: in that ye say , The table of the LORD [ is ] polluted ;

12.english_reference: and the fruit thereof , [ even ] his meat , [ is ] contemptible .

traditions.WLC: וְ נִיב֖ וֹ נִבְזֶ֥ה אָכְלֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ἐπιτιθέμενα ἐξουδένωνται βρώματα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et quod superpónitur contemptíbile est cum igne , qui illud dévorat .
traditions.KJV: and the fruit thereof , [ even ] his meat , [ is ] contemptible .

13.english_reference: Ye said also , Behold , what a weariness [ is it ] !

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴπατε Ταῦτα ἐκ κακοπαθίας ἐστίν .
traditions.KJV: Ye said also , Behold , what a weariness [ is it ] !

13.english_reference: and ye have snuffed at it , saith the LORD of hosts

traditions.WLC: וְ הִפַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹת֗ וֹ אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξεφύσησα αὐτά , λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ .
traditions.VUL: et exsufflástis illud , dicit Dóminus exercítuum ,
traditions.KJV: and ye have snuffed at it , saith the LORD of hosts ;

13.english_reference: and ye brought [ that which was ] torn , and the lame , and the sick

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲבֵאתֶ֣ם גָּז֗וּל וְ אֶת הַ פִּסֵּ֨חַ֙ וְ אֶת הַ֣ חוֹלֶ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσεφέρετε ἁρπάγματα καὶ τὰ χωλὰ καὶ τὰ ἐνοχλούμενα ·
traditions.VUL: et intulístis de rapínis claudum , et lánguidum ,
traditions.KJV: and ye brought [ that which was ] torn , and the lame , and the sick ;

13.english_reference: thus ye brought an offering : should I accept this of your hand ?

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם אֶת הַ מִּנְחָ֑ה הַ אֶרְצֶ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ הּ מִ יֶּדְ כֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν φέρητε τὴν θυσίαν , εἰ προσδέξομαι αὐτὰ ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν ὑμῶν ;
traditions.VUL: et intulístis munus : numquid suscípiam illud de manu vestra ,
traditions.KJV: thus ye brought an offering : should I accept this of your hand ?
saith the LORD .

14.english_reference: But cursed [ be ] the deceiver , which hath in his flock a male

traditions.WLC: וְ אָר֣וּר נוֹכֵ֗ל וְ יֵ֤שׁ בְּ עֶדְר וֹ֙ זָכָ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπικατάρατος ὃς ἦν δυνατός , καὶ ὑπῆρχεν ἐν τῷ ποιμνίῳ αὐτοῦ ἄρσεν ,
traditions.VUL: Maledíctus dolósus , qui habet in grege suo másculum ,
traditions.KJV: But cursed [ be ] the deceiver , which hath in his flock a male ,

14.english_reference: and voweth , and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing

traditions.WLC: וְ נֹדֵ֛ר וְ זֹבֵ֥חַ מָשְׁחָ֖ת לַֽ אדֹנָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὐχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ , καὶ θύει διεφθαρμένον τῷ κυρίῳ ·
traditions.VUL: et votum fáciens ímmolat débile Dómino :
traditions.KJV: and voweth , and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing :

14.english_reference: for I [ am ] a great King , saith the LORD of hosts

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ גָּד֜וֹל אָ֗נִי אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: διότι βασιλεὺς μέγας ἐγώ εἰμι , λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ ,
traditions.VUL: quia rex magnus ego , dicit Dóminus exercítuum ,
traditions.KJV: for I [ am ] a great King , saith the LORD of hosts ,

14.english_reference: and my name [ is ] dreadful among the heathen

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁמִ֖ י נוֹרָ֥א בַ גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐπιφανὲς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν .
traditions.VUL: et nomen meum horríbile in géntibus .
traditions.KJV: and my name [ is ] dreadful among the heathen .
